public_rationale: A primary evaluation of four commercial systems using retrieved content found both supported outputs and substantial citation failures. That directly supports the ordinary meaning of 'hit and miss' in the record available before the post. It does not imply that every unsupported sentence was false or that RAG offered no improvement.
limitations: Citation correctness is narrower than overall factual accuracy.
Results concern particular systems, versions, and queries.
No particular overall error rate is attributed to RAG as a whole.

statement.excerpt: The trouble is that so far RAG has been hit and miss.
statement.document_title: No, RAG is probably not going to rescue the current situation

our_interpretation: The plain reading is that retrieval-augmented systems had produced a mixture of successful answers and factual or citation failures.
The phrase does not specify equal numbers of successes and failures or claim that retrieval never improves performance.
'So far' describes the accumulated record through February 23, 2024. The target therefore has no asserted starting date.
criteria.support_condition: Contemporary evaluations of systems that condition generated answers on retrieved material document both supported outputs and material answer or citation failures.
criteria.contradiction_condition: Representative contemporary evaluations establish consistently reliable factual answers and citations across the relevant uses, and the alleged failures are shown not to involve retrieval-augmented generation or not to be failures.
